notes: "I then looked for existing work I could build on. I encountered the PPTD approach in the Kimi Slides ecosystem. OpenSlide already connected React pages to a canvas and editing tools. HUANDENG builds on the OpenSlide codebase, with a PPTD document model and an Electron desktop application. These existing projects gave me foundations to combine. OpenPPTD contributes the formula conversion modules.\n\nSources and precise attribution: sources/story/FACTS.md ; https://open-slide.dev/docs ; https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/office/open-xml/presentation/structure-of-a-presentationml-document ."
